strategy: progressive disclosure: load the hot path first, then open deferred artifacts only when their trigger is met.

required_files: target phase file named by the assignment or loop-state.active_phase
fallback_files: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/phase-manifest.md only when the target phase file is unknown
deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/README.md only when the harness intent is unclear
cold_start.rule: Do not load the full docs folder or every runtime artifact during cold start.

primary_context: repo paths named by the target phase contract
selected source slice named by context triggers
validation evidence cited by actor report

builder.rule: Builder/repair mode may load broad context; actor and critic modes may not.

deferred.README.md: do not load by default; open only when the phase intent or global rule is unclear
deferred.phase-manifest.md: do not load by default; open only when the target phase file or dependency order is unknown
deferred.source-packet.md: do not load by default; open only named sections for code fact lookup or writeback
deferred.loop-contract.json: do not load by default; open only if the loop cycle is unclear
deferred.feature-oracle.json: do not load whole file by default; inspect only the selected feature item
deferred.progress-log.md: do not load whole file by default; inspect only recent entries when blockers or status are unclear
deferred.agent-handoff.md: do not load by default; open only when next action or role handoff is unclear
deferred.continuity-ledger.md: do not load whole file by default; open only dependency boundary rows needed for the target phase or writeback
deferred.next-window-prompt.md: do not load by default; open only when preparing the next context window

forbidden: do not load the full docs folder
do not load all phase reports
do not load full source-packet.md when a named section or slice is enough
do not load unrelated repo modules not named by the phase contract
